name: @estebanforge/pi-glm-tweaks
description: Pi-native tweaks for Z.AI's GLM coding models (glm-5.2, glm-5.3, glm-5.3-flash, and [1m] variants). Restricts the Pi thinking-level UI to the modes each model supports on the wire, wires the native thinkingFormat:"zai" translation, and auto-clamps hidden
